items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: this boy, Joe Lyde, that used to play con-ed with the, uh, Last Straws... I always felt I had a big pair of shoes to fill when I went in this group.

ctx.x: Have you been to many, uh, parades that the Negro bands were playing? Uh, uh, on socials?

No, I can't say that I have. I think I maybe one of the few that live in New Orleans that hadn't been to a Negro funeral. You've never been there any. Uh, from what I can understand, uh, this boy, Joe Lyde, that used to play con-ed with the, uh, Last Straws, he'd march with the Negro, uh, parades already at funerals. He'd, uh, he'd march with them.
Mardi Gras, he was, uh. He played the Zulu. He played the Zulu parade almost all the way through then.
